cause: e564b54bc (J1.S2.T1) wrote _check_specs_only as an allowlist of paths (specs/), and 42bbdf11c widened it by one file (AGENTS.md); no rule defined which code a backlog tree authors, so the principal's release-pipeline commit, which only a merge brings, read as the tree's own code and no tree could land it.
context: The project gitflow is principal main, integration develop, work feature/ (specs/constitution.md:4). After the 0.5.0 promote the release pipeline committed fe3517b87 on the principal (release-please: .release-please-manifest.json, CHANGELOG.md, pyproject.toml to 0.5.0) and tagged v0.5.0; feature/0.5.0 still holds 0.4.7. scripts/guards/repo.py:520 published-floor needs the last tag <= the manifest, so `python scripts/ci.py job`, the verify: line, is red on the work branch, and ci.yml checks out with fetch-depth 0, so the next push's CI goes red too. In 0.4.7 a direct merge carried the release commit (a5673759e); the ref gate added in 0.5.0 refuses that now. The 0.5.0 squash came back by a keep-ours merge in a backlog tree (86e6945ea), which changed no path, while the release commit's paths must change. dd-gitflow-default §2 names no step that brings the principal's pipeline commit into the work line, and `release.py ship` writes specs state only.
expected: After a promote, the work line takes the principal's release commit through a tree the law names, whose merge accepts exactly the paths that merging the principal into the work branch yields (the gitflow's step-2 git merge-tree test), so the verify line returns to green with no direct merge, and every refusal on the way names a fix that runs.
repro: cd <workspace root> && .dadaia/.venv/bin/dadaia worktree new dadaia-workspace 0.5.0/wt-backlog-x && (cd worktrees/dadaia-workspace/0.5.0/wt-backlog-x && git merge --no-ff --no-commit origin/main; git checkout --ours specs/bugs/BUGS.jsonl && git add specs/bugs/BUGS.jsonl && git commit -qm m) && .dadaia/.venv/bin/dadaia worktree merge worktrees/dadaia-workspace/0.5.0/wt-backlog-x  # dc18fc17d: [error] .release-please-manifest.json is code; a backlog tree lands specs/ and AGENTS.md only — code lands through a job
solution: _check_specs_only counts a changed path outside specs/ and AGENTS.md as the tree's code unless HEAD holds it exactly as git merge-tree --write-tree <work> <principal ref> yields (the gitflow step-2 test, the principal from the gitflow reader): a merge-only path lands, an authored, set-back or conflicted one is refused. Law: worktrees-AGENTS.md backlog merge row, dd-gitflow-default step 11 and section 3a shape 14. Pin: test__worktree_end.py::test_a_backlog_tree_lands_the_paths_merging_the_principal_yields.
symptom: `git commit` of that merge on feature/0.5.0: '[ref-gate] BLOCKED ... fix: Agent action: open a tree for this change ... the name of a live job, a backlog slug or a hotfix bug id'. `dadaia worktree merge` of a wt-backlog tree holding the merge: '[error] .release-please-manifest.json is code; a backlog tree lands specs/ and AGENTS.md only — code lands through a job', whose fix line reverts the manifest and keeps the verify red. No rc is in IMPLEMENTATION, so no job tree opens, and a wt-hotfix tree needs a registered bug. A BLOCK whose fix is itself blocked is a Stall.
title: After a release the work branch cannot take the principal's release commit: the ref gate refuses a direct merge and names a backlog tree, the backlog merge refuses the manifest, CHANGELOG and pyproject as code, and no job tree can open, so the work branch's verify line stays red
